title: A Room for the Portrait
author: O. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Theo Hartwell, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
